existing_rows_audit.detail: Minghong's Shanghai HQ and its research hiring are both real and current: an experienced-hire researcher req is live at https://join.mhfunds.com/index/position/7281148138903423286/detail (posted title 'AI 算法研究员 Quantitative Researcher - Machine Learning (Experienced Hire)', Shanghai / Hong Kong / New York) and a campus req at https://join.mhfunds.com/index/position/7538744389126211850/detail. Two corrections to the row, however: (1) the eligibility note 'recent grads accepted; you qualify' conflates the two — the plain '量化研究员' title only exists as a 2026校招 student-gated campus requisition, while the experienced-hire researcher req is ML-specific and asks for MSc/PhD plus modelling experience; (2) the comp figure '¥600k-1.2M' is not stated on any Minghong posting or on the AMAC registry and I found no credible source for it, so it should be treated as unsourced. The 'Source / Verify' link (gs.amac.org.cn) evidences entity registration only, not any role — the firm's own board at https://join.mhfunds.com/index/position is the correct verification source.

notes:
Careers portal is https://join.mhfunds.com (Feishu/Lark ATS, tenant of record 上海玖思科技有限公司) with an English marketing front at https://talent.mhfunds.com. The board is a JavaScript SPA backed by a GraphQL endpoint and returns an empty shell to plain HTTP fetches; I enumerated it by rendering each page through a JS-executing text proxy, paginating with the ?current=N query parameter. 24 live requisitions total across 3 pages, all read individually for the ones listed above.

Offices: talent.mhfunds.com states Shanghai, Beijing, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York. Beijing and New York are out of scope. Singapore is listed as an office on the firm's own site but has ZERO live postings on the board, so no Singapore roles are claimed here. No European, UK or Tokyo presence — the firm has none.

Onshore vs offshore: the onshore manager is 上海明汯投资管理有限公司, registered as a private fund manager with AMAC (gs.amac.org.cn) — that registry confirms entity existence only and carries no job data. The Hong Kong arm was opened in 2019 and is reported in press to operate under the name Jupiter Research with founder Qiu Huiming as a key person; I could not verify its SFC licence number directly, so treat the HK entity's legal name as reported-secondary. Notably the HK-tagged reqs are posted on the same mainland ATS tenant.

Mandarin: this is a Mandarin-first shop. Of the roles listed, the bilingual (Chinese + English) postings are Research Engineer, AI 算法研究员 Quantitative Researcher - ML (Experienced), 量化开发工程师 Quantitative Developer, C++ Developer - Quantitative Trading System and 量化开发工程师（Data方向）; everything else is Chinese-only, which in practice signals a Mandarin working requirement. The Hong Kong seats on the bilingual reqs are the most English-tolerant option, but even those job descriptions are written Chinese-first. Only one posting on the entire board is English-only (Trading Support Engineer, Hong Kong).

Excluded as out of scope: five internship requisitions (2026实习, Shanghai/Beijing/HK — student-gated and short-term); 服务器运维工程师 (server ops, Shanghai); 高性能交易系统运维工程师 SRE/Operations Engineer Trading Systems (Shanghai, ops shift work); Trading Support Engineer (Hong Kong — English-only but a Python/SQL SRE role requiring 3+ years production/SRE experience, not a C++ seat); Quantitative Analyst 量化分析师 (Hong Kong — despite the title this is trade-support/fund-operations data work in Python, not research or trading); 交易后数据工程师 Post Trading Data Engineer and 数据开发工程师 Data Engineer (Shanghai, pure data engineering).

No Trader-track roles exist anywhere on the board. No compensation figures are stated on any Minghong posting, so every comp_local is left empty. Applications also accepted by email at HR@mhfunds.com (experienced) and campushr@mhfunds.com (campus).
